parameters.query:
SELECT sp.post_no, s.views, s.reactions, coalesce(t.title, left(sp.text, 80)) AS title,
       rp.id AS ryzh_post_id
FROM content_source_posts sp
JOIN content_sources c ON c.username = sp.source AND c.is_own
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT views, reactions FROM content_post_snapshots
              WHERE source = sp.source AND post_no = sp.post_no
              ORDER BY captured_at DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true
LEFT JOIN ryzh_posts rp ON rp.channel_message_id = sp.post_no
LEFT JOIN ryzh_topics t ON t.id = rp.topic_id
WHERE sp.posted_at > now() - interval '9 days'
  AND sp.posted_at < now() - interval '2 days'
ORDER BY s.views DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT chat_id FROM ryzh_editors ORDER BY chat_id;
